summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem has become the de facto open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services through structured JSON-RPC interfaces. By 2026, the ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that secure and route traffic, and thousands of individual servers for specific tools. This matters because MCP lets AI agents reliably take real-world actions—querying databases, controlling browsers, managing repos—without bespoke integrations.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (like Composio, Smithery) provide managed access to many MCP servers through a single endpoint; gateways (like agentgateway, Cloudflare MCP) proxy, secure, and route MCP traffic; and individual servers (like Playwright MCP, GitHub MCP) expose the tools of one specific service.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation via accessibility tree snapshots; exposes 25+ tools for LLM-driven navigation, clicking, form filling, and testing without vision models
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source (@playwright/mcp npm package)
strengths: Most-used MCP server in the community by public usage rankings
No screenshot/vision processing required—uses structured accessibility trees
First-class CI/CD support (GitHub Actions)
Backed by Microsoft and the mature Playwright project
tools.best_for: AI-driven browser testing and web automation in CI/CD pipelines

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, and code search via OAuth-secured remote endpoint
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server from GitHub
Ubiquitous in developer workflows (issue triage, PR review, repo automation)
Native support across Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex
Eliminates local credential leakage risk
tools.best_for: Automating repository, issue, and pull request workflows from AI agents

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: A managed endpoint for 1,500+ apps with managed authentication, structured schemas, and dynamic tool routing
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher volume and enterprise features
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform with a self-learning tool-selection layer
Repeat tasks run ~30% more accurately on 2x fewer tokens vs cold start
30,000+ GitHub stars with 4,800+ forks
Managed OAuth and authentication across 1,500+ integrations
tools.best_for: Teams needing managed, multi-app tool access with authentication handled for them

tools.name: Context7
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples injected into agent context
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid Upstash plans for higher rate limits
strengths: Consistently cited as a top pick alongside GitHub and Playwright for Cursor and Codex
Eliminates outdated/hallucinated library documentation
Simple drop-in setup across major IDEs
Broad community adoption
tools.best_for: Giving coding agents accurate, current documentation for libraries and frameworks

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A registry and hosting platform for thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting/enterprise tiers for managed deployments
strengths: Largest MCP server registry for discovery
One-click install into popular clients
Hosted deployment removes local setup
Strong community adoption as a discovery hub
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Filesystem MCP
tools.connects_to: Local file system access—reading, writing, and searching files and directories
strengths: Reference server maintained in the official MCP repo
One of the most-installed servers for local development
Essential building block for coding agents
Simple, well-documented
tools.best_for: Giving agents controlled access to local files and directories

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting and gateway on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth, routing, and edge deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and features
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting on the edge
Built-in OAuth and authorization support
Scales globally with low latency
Strong documentation and growing adoption
tools.best_for: Deploying and gatewaying secure remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, and frames—enabling design-to-code and design context for agents
tools.pricing_paid: Free for Figma users; included with Figma plans
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server from Figma
Unlocks design-to-code workflows for AI agents
Direct access to design tokens and components
Popular among front-end and design-engineering teams
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into code and feeding design context to agents

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase databases, auth, storage, and edge functions via OAuth-secured remote endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid Supabase project plans
strengths: Official remote MCP server from Supabase
Lets agents query and manage Postgres databases directly
OAuth-secured and CI-friendly
Popular in full-stack agent workflows
tools.best_for: Letting agents manage databases, auth, and backend resources on Supabase

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation—triggering and building automations across hundreds of integrated apps
tools.pricing_paid: Free self-hosted; paid n8n Cloud plans
strengths: Bridges MCP agents into n8n's large automation ecosystem
Both server and client MCP support
Self-hostable and open source
Connects agents to hundreds of downstream app integrations
tools.best_for: Orchestrating multi-app automation workflows from AI agents

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers via the Docker MCP Catalog and Toolkit with isolated, secure execution
tools.pricing_paid: Free; included with Docker Desktop/Docker plans
strengths: Runs MCP servers in isolated containers for security
Curated MCP Catalog of verified images
Integrated into Docker Desktop (huge existing developer base)
Simplifies setup and credential management
tools.best_for: Securely running and managing MCP servers in isolated containers

tools.name: Stripe MCP
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments, customers, invoices, and billing data via OAuth-secured remote endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Free to use; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server from Stripe
Enables agents to query and manage payment/billing workflows
CI-friendly with no local credential storage
Backed by widely adopted Stripe platform
tools.best_for: Automating payment, billing, and customer workflows from AI agents
